body: The Meadow from the prototype is built and merged (PRs #241 to #243, #245, #247), with its spec approved (c1) and its Steps shipped through mitosis (c2). Its cleanup is finished and the spec's load-time wording follows the owner's decision. The open frame-rate criterion was moved to thread meadow-sweep (decision 01M42HJSPQDCY11HDQG62F56PJ), which carries the 2026-10-03 device measurements.
